notes: Compact courtyard geometry to maximize internal thermal inertia.
Thick rammed earth/brick perimeter walls attenuate intense daytime heat gain.
Small exterior apertures with deep reveals minimize solar insolation on hot facades.
Central courtyard facilitates nocturnal long-wave radiation cooling to the night sky.
Balanced courtyard layout adaptable to both hot dry summers and cool winters.
Seasonal courtyard shading prevents summer overheating while admitting winter sun.
Moderate-to-high thermal mass evens out extreme seasonal diurnal swings.
Linear east-west elongation maximizing north and south facades for cross-ventilation.
Deep 1.2m roof overhangs and shaded verandah deflect high tropical sun and driving monsoon rain.
Continuous window louvers along prevailing wind axes induce continuous convective air currents.
Steep 42° gabled roof naturally sheds heavy alpine snow loads.
Direct gain passive solar aperture on South facade maximizes winter heat harvesting.
Protected double-door entry airlock buffer seals against sub-zero northern drafts.
Thick insulated thermal envelope retains indoor hearth and solar warmth.
Balanced envelope opening into shaded garden and outdoor living terrace.
Moderate thermal mass and cross-daylighting deliver passive thermal comfort year-round.
